---
title: "Queue"
subtitle: "Visualise a queue of items as it is updated"
---

## Sandbox

```{=html}
<div class="panel-grid panel-grid--stack">
  <div class="panel">
    <div id="queue-editor"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="panel">
    <div id="queue-viz"></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { PythonEditorInput } from "./js/utils/python-editor-input.js";
import { mountQueueViz, queueStarterCode } from "./js/queue-viz.js";

queueEditor = PythonEditorInput.mountPlayable(
  document.querySelector("#queue-editor"),
  {
    heading: "Python",
    defaultCode: queueStarterCode,
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queueViz = mountQueueViz(document.querySelector("#queue-viz"), {
  editor: queueEditor,
})
```
